records.note: Yahoo open exceeded high; rejected candle, independent complete same-session TradingView candle corroborates current and previous close. Original precision of adjusted close preserved. No arbitrary OHLC repair.

scopeNote: 134 US/Europe listings only; 113 Asian completed-session observations preserved. Market-cap, FX and financial timestamps/values preserved, not certified as October30 observations. No paid sources or authentication. Company charts use adjusted closes, not unadjusted close returns.

metadataPreservation.marketCap: Existing source-observed capitalization and timestamps retained. Not independently certified as October30 closing capitalization.
metadataPreservation.shares: No newly verified shares-outstanding reference date; no guessed latest shares used.
metadataPreservation.fx: Existing fx value and associated provenance retained, not relabeled as current.
metadataPreservation.financial: Price-only refresh preserves all quarter values and financialCheckedAt. Official financial backfills are separately sourced.
metadataPreservation.listingIdentity: 134 source ticker and currency values matched maintained exchange-qualified company mappings; this is not an exhaustive corporate-action announcement audit.

sourceReuse.note: Three overlapping adjusted histories were fully re-fetched from their original start dates when provider revisions were detected; no existing date was dropped.
